<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 56 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `25b001cc0ad38f2ed0d1b5c9ca5dd447d7709085` — the merge of head `ffa2ad230ccdf712106b653eb18bc6a578ba9ac3` into base `f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 25b001cc0ad38f2ed0d1b5c9ca5dd447d7709085 && git checkout 25b001cc0ad38f2ed0d1b5c9ca5dd447d7709085
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587 ffa2ad230ccdf712106b653eb18bc6a578ba9ac3 && git checkout -B drift-repro f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587 && git merge --no-ff ffa2ad230ccdf712106b653eb18bc6a578ba9ac3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f4dbcc2153566226f283c79c73255369c2c97587` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两处 Setup 结果文案只说真话。① 没配邮件的部署上，邀请用户 / 重发邀请的结果提示不再叫管理员去用「复制邀请链接」，改为说明：接受邀请需要已验证邮箱，没邮件时只有通过社交或 SSO 登录验证了地址的人能接受，其他人由平台管理员直接建账号。② 导入用户结果里的「已在待激活中，已再次通知」改为「已在待激活中」（停用的待激活人员并不会被通知，旁边一列写着「未通知原因：已停用」，原文自相矛盾）。11 种语言同步。
- 为什么改：#34883 之后接受邀请必须有已验证邮箱，旧提示让管理员去发一个对方用不了的链接。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案和生成的译文，不改行为（结果、动作、复制邀请链接本身都不变）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`invite-outcome-messages.ts` 两句 `link_only`；`sys-user.object.ts` 两个标签。
- 两分钟验证：在没配邮件的部署上邀请一个用户，提示里不再出现「复制邀请链接」，改为说明谁能接受、其他人怎么办。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、224 行）。L1 意见：两张卡合并合规，文案与 self-hosting 文档一致，可落；QA 清单里有一行还写着旧句子，已要求区补一张跟进卡。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `ffa2ad230ccdf712106b653eb18bc6a578ba9ac3` · 2026-11-19T01:43Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 17 files, +143/−81, 5 commits (per card one fix + one test commit, one merge of `origin/main`). Closes #34889 and #35164 (folded). `check-governed-merges --pr 35274`: 0 of 17 paths governed, 224 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **Fold:** claim 6995514978 records the five fold gates (one defect shape, one package and changeset, both p2, each checkable on its own sentence, explicit exclusions). Holds on the diff: both changes are outcome / result copy in `platform-objects` identity.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34889-identity-outcome-copy.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/platform-objects` (published). Sentences read against the diff: "Invite User (Users, Members, Invitations, the organization page) and Resend Invitation no longer tell the admin to use Copy Invite Link" = the four `invite_user` mirrors + `resend_invitation` in every bundle (5 `link_only` lines per locale); "only an invitee whose social or SSO sign-in verifies the address can accept … a platform administrator creates the account" = the new producer text; "Nothing else changes" = no handler or action shape touched; "labels its `alreadyPending` count and column 'Already pending'" = the two label edits in `sys-user.object.ts`, mirrored in every bundle (2 lines per locale). 11 bundles × 7 changed lines each, generated (en) and translated (10).
- **前提:** #34889 lands after #34883 (merged); the verified-address rule and the operator path are what `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` already states (dev reading A1). This supersedes the hand-over sentence that ruling E on #27797 put in place; the change is the follow-up the #34883 contract review itself owed, so it is a correction downstream of a merged security ruling, not a new reading for the maintainer. `sys-invitation.object.ts` comment updated to match.
- **Pins:** `invitation-delivery-copy.test.ts`: for `invite_user` (all mirrors) and `resend_invitation`, the `link_only` copy does not contain the Copy Invite Link action label, in English and in every translated bundle against that bundle's own label. `cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`: field and column read "Already pending", and the `host.notified` column still carries "told". Ablations: old sentence back → 2 red; old label back → 1 red; both restored blob == HEAD.
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `ffa2ad23`: 37 success, 16 skipped (UI families and opt-ins), 0 failure. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core (10/10 shards), Build Core, Check Changeset, Flag docs affected all `success`. Dev local: 66 of 67 derived families exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED (needs every dist), covered by CI's Lint families on this head.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) the released 18.5.0 `CHANGELOG.md` sentence #35164 names went to a separate docs-only PR #35275 (`Part of #35164`, `skip-changeset`) instead of this PR: correct, AGENTS.md makes released CHANGELOG entries docs-only-PR territory; this PR keeps the closing keyword for #35164. (2) Commit shape per card is fix + test instead of one commit, because a force push was refused; the repository squashes, no effect on `main`. (3) Model-free trailers per AGENTS.md.
- **范围外去向 (follow-up owed):** this PR makes two in-repo readings false, neither published: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ux-conventions.json` line 27, a FIXED regression row with expected PASS, quotes the old `link_only` sentence verbatim as the expected toast, so the next checklist run of that row on a no-mail deployment will read FAIL; and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.inviteOutcome-27797.test.tsx` keeps a local `LINK_ONLY_TAIL` fixture with the old sentence (stays green, but no longer mirrors the producer). Not a REWORK reason (outside the claim's file surface, non-published), but "noted, not filed" is not enough: ux-3 files one follow-up card covering both and names it in the close-out.
- **落地条款:** K = 2 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `e8a78c4b` (< 15), no new locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ux-3 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT; on MERGED, close-out on #34889 and #35164 (the latter also naming #35275), with the follow-up card number.
